title: Tooling: 2.87× faster ternary verify_invocation_frames with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, the historical ternary-side small controls (`scripts/audit_ternary_side.py` on `h=8,9`) spend almost all wall time in `scripts/experiments/ternary_side.py:verify_invocation_frames`. Profiling shows repeated `Fraction` matrix products/inverses while building Gram projections, and repeated `rank(sub(F, old))` work on recurring physical edges.

This PR keeps the default checker path and:

1. clears denominators once per Gram factor for products and clears the pivot row before Gauss–Jordan scaling for inverses (same rational values as the historical entrywise `Fraction` arithmetic);
2. memos exact ordered frame transitions for one `verify_invocation_frames` call by identity-then-value interning;
3. caches projections on immutable row tuples within the call.

Every support/topology `require`, both orientations, and every orientation evidence field stay identical. Only the `scripts/experiments/ternary_side.py` source pin changes inside `certificates/ternary-side.json`. The h=29 DAG construction and assembly invoice are not replayed. Open [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1922](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1922)'s `audit_joint_frames.py` edit is left independent; this answers that PR's open ternary inverse question on the ternary frame stream only.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 (Linux-6.12.94+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39), five alternating fresh-process pairs timing `build(..., retain_graph=True)` plus `verify_invocation_frames` for `h=8` and `h=9` gave median wall time **13.578 → 4.733 seconds (2.87×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Every orientation receipt matches the baseline checker fieldwise.

Package: `research/ternary-frame-cleared-cache/`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/ternary-frame-cleared-cache/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/ternary-frame-cleared-cache/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ternary-frame-cleared-cache
python3.12 -I -B research/ternary-frame-cleared-cache/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_TERNARY_FRAME_CLEARED_CACHE frame_cases=2 product_cases=160 certs=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/ternary-frame-cleared-cache outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_TERNARY_FRAME_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Cleared-product scale-omission and poisoned transition-memo foils reject. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different objects or delivery): [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1217](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1217) (opt-in ternary frame-pair memo; credited, not re-opened), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1922](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1922) (cleared product + open ternary inverse question; `audit_joint_frames.py` left independent), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1793](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1793), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1861), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1984), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1994](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1994). No competing open PR on the default `verify_invocation_frames` path at refresh.

Douglas R. Colkitt authored the ternary checker; Zhihao Chen’s #7 supplied the five-subset motif. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
